about: N12 (T 2026-11-18, "Not good.") — time-sensitive questions use the web search with recency and never Wikipedia; stable reference keeps Wikipedia. TS-* = time-sensitive (no key: the app says plainly it can't look up today's news; with a key: web only, a news/recency window). REF-* = stable reference (Wikipedia stays: no key → Wikipedia; key → web + Wikipedia). Generic public topics only.
